title: Ridon: VP’s defense for bank records is to push blame toward dad

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s strategy after being confronted with bank documents bearing her name seemed to lean on pushing the liability towards her father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, commented Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon. Ridon, in an interview after Duterte’s impeachment trial on Wednesday, greeted Duterte—who is currently detained at the International Criminal Court (ICC) in the Netherlands on charges of crimes against humanity—saying that his daughter is pushing the blame toward him. The lawmaker was referring to the defense’s line of questioning during the proceedings, after the prosecution quizzed the Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) […]...
